bug_semantics: getRecommendTitleFromMarkdownString applies /#{1,6} {1,}(.*\S.*)(?:\n|$)/g to the complete Markdown string when choosing a filename during save/save-as. For a heading prefix followed by a very long run of spaces and then a newline, there is no required non-space character before the newline. The engine repeatedly repartitions that run between the adjacent ` {1,}` and `.*` repetitions and repeatedly scans for `\S`, producing super-linear (quadratic) backtracking and main-process CPU exhaustion before the save dialog can proceed.
flaw_origin: PR #1281 tried to prevent an exception for whitespace-only headings by replacing the previous `(.+)` capture with `(.*\S.*)`. Its sole original member commit ba9865a0fc7df8052b3cdd1b928aaa28215bcb64 first created the overlapping-quantifier failure mechanism in src/main/utils/index.js. GitHub's one-parent integration object 15f8c7b2c57296370e06e743702101a11c2ac809 has the same parent/tree patch, and dee8bb6f5b8a8e19a6e117f673c93f9dcad4aae1 replayed the patch onto the release line; neither carrier is smaller than the recovered PR member.
ai_marker: absent: raw BIC commit object ba9865a0fc7df8052b3cdd1b928aaa28215bcb64 names author and committer `Felix Häusler <hfelix@protonmail.ch>` and its complete message is `Fix recommend title exception when heading contains spaces only`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot identity, AI tool/model name, or other AI-attribution trailer.
evidence: Advisory GHSA-295x-89h7-9wpm / CVE-2025-6492 names getRecommendTitleFromMarkdownString in src/main/utils/index.js and references https://github.com/marktext/marktext/pull/3952. That PR's published reproduction uses `'#' + ' '.repeat(100000) + '\n1\n'`; its head, confirmed by `git ls-remote origin refs/pull/3952/head`, is c59b3ad423dfa082869933baf9f5d5c69bdcc560 and changes the regex to add `(?! )`. The PR is closed and has no merge ref. `git branch --all --contains c59...` and `git tag --contains c59...` return nothing, `git merge-base --is-ancestor c59... develop` returns 1, and `git log --all -S'(?! )' -- src/main/utils/index.js packages/desktop/src/main/utils/index.ts` finds no integrated fix. Vulnerable call sites remain at packages/desktop/src/main/menu/actions/file.ts:170 and :354, where save/save-as passes the Markdown string to the helper. For origin, `git ls-remote origin refs/pull/1281/head` resolves ba9865a0fc7df8052b3cdd1b928aaa28215bcb64; `git rev-list --count 04480e08ae8987b50cd17e08844f742ca40635f7..ba986...` is 1. `git show ba986... -- src/main/utils/index.js` changes `(.+)` to `(.*\S.*)`, while direct parent-tree inspection with `git show 04480e08ae8987b50cd17e08844f742ca40635f7:src/main/utils/index.js` shows only the predecessor regex and no vulnerable `(.*\S.*)` line. `git diff --exit-code ba986... 15f8c7b2c57296370e06e743702101a11c2ac809 -- src/main/utils/index.js` returns 0, proving the recovered PR member and squash carrier have identical file content. `git log -L` also identifies parallel release replay dee8bb6f5b8a8e19a6e117f673c93f9dcad4aae1. Version-tree checks show v0.15.0 has `(.+)`, v0.15.1 and advisory-listed v0.17.1 have `(.*\S.*)`, and both v0.19.1 (d218718c45895cd9893d535b3eb7b5e7e49d7bbc, 2026-06-05) and develop e52106fd1cdcbd33c1258b7b0cdc7013c4c5d86c retain the same vulnerable regex after its move to packages/desktop/src/main/utils/index.ts. Thus v0.15.1 is the first observed vulnerable tag, while the advisory's `up to 0.17.1` endpoint is not a patched boundary.
reasoning: The lifecycle begins with the safe-for-this-mechanism v0.15.0 form ` {1,}(.+)`. PR #1281 fixed a whitespace-only-heading crash by requiring a non-space via `(.*\S.*)`, but that placed a broad repetition capable of consuming spaces after another space repetition. On a long all-space would-be heading, the required `\S` cannot succeed and the engine explores a quadratic number of splits. The clean PR head contains one commit, ba9865a0fc7df8052b3cdd1b928aaa28215bcb64, so it is the smallest BIC; 15f8c7b2c57296370e06e743702101a11c2ac809 is the same-tree squash carrier and dee8bb6f5b8a8e19a6e117f673c93f9dcad4aae1 is a parallel release replay, not a more original BIC. The BIC's immediate parent was inspected directly and lacks `(.*\S.*)`, establishing parent absence. Tags establish introduction between v0.15.0 and v0.15.1 and persistence through v0.17.1. PR #3952's direct one-line mitigation c59b3ad423dfa082869933baf9f5d5c69bdcc560 adds a lookahead that prevents handing spaces back into the broad capture, but it was never merged; later v0.19.1 and current develop are still vulnerable, so no upstream fix SHA or patched version boundary exists. Finally, the only admissible AI evidence is the raw ba986... commit object: it has a human author/committer and no AI marker, yielding NOT_AI regardless of any later PR tooling or comments.
remaining_gap: Upstream remains unpatched: direct mitigation commit c59b3ad423dfa082869933baf9f5d5c69bdcc560 is only the closed, unmerged PR #3952 head, so there is no merged fix_sha or patched version boundary through v0.19.1 and develop e52106fd1cdcbd33c1258b7b0cdc7013c4c5d86c.
